name: print-social-hand-drawn-kraft-paper-cafe-event-poster
title: Hand-Drawn Paper Cafe Event Poster
whatItIs: A torn cream paper sheet clipped over a street cafe photo, filled with quirky brown hand-lettered text (Consider this your marketing upgrade), a scribbled date oval, star doodles, font callouts and a line illustration of friends at a table.
whatItMeans: The handmade, single-colour look feels warm and intimate, like a friendly note, ideal for a casual meetup.
techniques: Torn-edge paper texture on top of a real photo
Scribbled ellipse around the date and time
Annotation arrows and labels as decoration
bestFor: Brands wanting a personal, crafted tone

vocabulary.definition: A ragged border imitating hand-torn paper.
Hand-drawn notes and arrows added as visual flavour.
A design using a single ink colour on a light stock.
